title: DropObject - ObjectReference
content:
Member of: ObjectReference Script Drops the specified base object from this object's inventory. Syntax: ObjectReference Function DropObject(Form akObject, int aiCount = 1) native Parameters: - akObject: The base object to drop from the inventory. - aiCount: How many to drop Default: 1 Return Value: The object that was dropped. Examples: ; Drops one chest from the player's inventory, and unlocks it Game.GetPlayer().DropObject(ChestProperty).Lock(false)
; Drops one hundred arrows from the player's inventory Game.GetPlayer().DropObject(ArrowProperty, 100) Notes: This will not drop a specific reference - if you want to drop a specific reference, then call Drop() on it instead. See Also: - ObjectReference Script - Drop - ObjectReference - DropFirstObject - ObjectReference
